picks.headline: Google releases Gemini 3.8 Live models with WebSocket API support
picks.why: Expands Google's speech-to-speech offerings with real-time duplex interaction and extended reasoning capabilities.
picks.title: Gemini Live audio

picks.headline: Adversarial benchmark forces program repair agents to write insecure code
picks.why: Demonstrates that security-focused code agents can be tricked into generating functionally correct but vulnerable patches over half the time.
picks.title: Adversarial Testing of Automated Program Repair Agents for Security Vulnerabilities

picks.headline: Decoy Direction Optimization neutralizes weight-ablation safety bypass attacks
picks.why: Provides a post-hoc weight editing defense that misleads refusal feature ablation attacks into targeting harmless orthogonal directions.
picks.title: Decoy Direction Optimization: A Post-Hoc Defense Against LLM Abliteration

picks.headline: NVIDIA introduces DSX platform for grid-responsive GPU power management
picks.why: Enables AI data centers to dynamically throttle and allocate power budgets in response to real-time grid demand signals.
picks.title: From Megawatts to Tokens: How NVIDIA Maximizes AI Factory Production

picks.headline: Novita AI open-sources Chord for faster INT4 MoE inference
picks.why: Delivers up to 2.15x speedups on Blackwell B300 GPUs by optimizing W4A16 MoE execution shapes.
picks.title: vLLM x Novita AI: Chord, Faster INT4 MoE for Kimi K2.x. Up to 1.3x on H200, 2.15x on Untuned B300

picks.headline: Study defines structural architecture requirements for tool-using AI agent authorization
picks.why: Establishes a foundational framework to prevent unauthorized tool execution and privilege escalation in agentic systems.
picks.title: Authorization Architectures for Tool-Using AI Agents

papers.headline: LoopSpec enables 6.83x inference speedup on looped Transformers
papers.why: Applies pipelined self-speculative decoding without extra training or quality loss to significantly accelerate recurrent Transformer execution.
papers.title: LoopSpec: Pipelined Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers

papers.headline: GrowMTP trains speculative decoding draft heads during RL post-training
papers.why: Allows draft models to grow online using existing verification signals without altering the underlying policy backbone.
papers.title: GrowMTP: Can RL Grow Its Own Draft Head?

papers.headline: JustFit serves 200K context LLMs on 24GB consumer laptops
papers.why: Uses just-in-time state management to bypass memory limitations when running long-context models on resource-constrained hardware.
papers.title: JustFit: 200K-Token LLM Serving on a 24 GiB Laptop with Just-in-Time State Management
